explanation: Encodes Erdős's [Er84] speculation from erdosproblems.com/211 that there are at least (1+o(1))kn/6 determined lines, with the o(1) uniform in 1 ≤ k < n as n → ∞. This is a reasonable precise reading. The near-pencil (k = 1, n lines) and the no-four-collinear examples (k ≈ n, ~n²/6 lines) show it is consistent and sharp. Erdős himself says it may be 'too optimistic', and it is correctly marked open.
